en: The Buddha-spoken Dhāraṇī for the Eyes:
*tuai mo fu*, *pan mo fu*, *e t’a pan mo fu*,
*jiu li fu*, *jiu li bi fu*, *jiu la jiu xi bi fu*, *sha li sa xi po*.
Ti-fu, Yi-li-fu, Yi-luo-yi-fu, Yi-la-bie-fu. If one recites this mantra seven times for eye pain, it will be immediately cured.
The Sutra on the Buddha’s Teaching of the Mantra for the Eyes.
